prompt:
This image is one page of a landscape drawing package: a coloured plan delivered as a picture, with no CAD file behind it. Read what is needed to measure it:
- entries: every filled area type and plant symbol the plan uses, from the legend box and from areas labelled directly on the plan (a bed or a lawn labelled in place is an entry too): label, the text exactly as written; swatch_colour_word, the fill colour you see, as one or two plain English colour words an image segmentation model can be prompted with (for example 'light green', 'grey'), never the material's name; kind, 'area' for a filled region, 'symbol' for a plant symbol such as a tree, 'line' for a line or strip such as a hedge; where, 'legend' or 'plan'; x and y, for an entry labelled on the plan, the centre of its label text normalised to 0-1000 (x from the left edge, y from the top edge of the image), 0 and 0 for a legend entry.
- legend_box: the legend box's corners, x0 y0 (top left) and x1 y1 (bottom right), each normalised to 0-1000 with x from the left edge and y from the top edge of the image; all 0 when there is no legend box.
- scale_bar: the graphic scale bar: x_start and x_end, the x of its zero end and of its far labelled end, y, the bar's centre line, all normalised to 0-1000 as above, and distance_m, the distance in metres its far label states; all 0 when there is none.
- title_scale: the scale written in the title block (for example '1:200'), empty if none.
- confidence from 0 to 1, and why in one sentence.

entries.label: FIRE TRUCK ACCESS LANE — KEEP CLEAR
EXISTING CAMPHOR DBH 95 cm — TO BE REMOVED

result.why: Legend box, on-plan area labels, graphic 0-10m scale bar and 1:200 title-block scale are all clearly legible.
